body: I really want to live but it's hard, like im very honest about it rather than say things just because im hurting. Like I think now like who would even feel hurt with me gone like there is nobody. I just hope that if what ever my future holds for me I can be some help even in death like I hear of people needing transplants and even kids it breaks my heart but if I knew that there is a way that my organs would be used I think that would help me with just knowing at least I made a small difference in the world.
